TEXT:
[FI] For the sake of gathering data for the new game, 
we ended up in... Well, it's not anywhere special, it's 
just the same old familiar Akihabara.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Senpai, you're late.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No I'm not. I'm right on time.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] You're 20 seconds late. In times like this, it's best to 
arrive at least 5 minutes early.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah, yeah, you sure pay attention to the trivial 
things. Now, we better get going before your 
schedule's all ruined.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Okay, let us depart-

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] ...Ugh, again...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] No... It's nothing.
[FI] As she said that, Sena replied to a text. Soon after...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What, it's mine this time?

[FI] The text I received was from Akagi. It said, "Are 
you really together with Sena-chan?"

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] ...Hey, did you send Akagi a text saying we were 
together?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Yes, I got a text that said, "Sena-chan, where are 
you?" so that's how I replied.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Check this out.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] ...? Eh, isn't this from Onii-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I can't tell if your brother is a real worrywart, or...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] He really doesn't trust me, that Onii-chan...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah. It's been bad lately.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] When Onii-chan isn't around, he gets worked up 
worrying if you're clinging to another guy... He must 
be nervous.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=33]Not me![/font_size] He's worrying about you?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Huh? Is that so?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] *sigh*... We haven't even gone anywhere and I 
already feel exhausted...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] I'm sorry, because of Onii-chan...

[FI] It's not just your brother, you're at fault too. It 
sure is complicated getting between these two 
siblings.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah, well... it's probably best to resolve this 
misunderstanding to clear his suspicions. I'll reply 
saying you're hanging out with me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Ah, then how about this, Senpai?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Come over here for a bit.

[FI] Sena grabbed onto my arm. Her chest was rubbing 
up against it.

[FI] Is this brat doing this on purpose? Cause it feels 
great, so more, please... Just as my mind went wild-

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] If we send a photo of the two of us together, even 
Onii-chan won't get suspicious.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] A...Ah, sure.

[FI] ...Her face... Her face is too close. Smells kinda good 
though. As expected from a girl.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] ? What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] U-Uh, it's nothing.

[FI] Man, seriously... The two of us taking a photo 
together... What are we, lovers? My heart's beating 
like crazy.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Since that's done, let's depart on our study trip!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I absolutely have to get you to 
[font_size=28]understand[/font_size] BL!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Eh?

[FI] Yeah, that's right... Coming to Akiba with her at this 
stage, I can't imagine this as a date.
[FI] Why? Because she's rotten to the core.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I'm a bit of an omnivore so I would go for anything, 
but I think you're the type to mix a lot of genres 
together...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] The world of BL is deep beyond measure! 
Welcome! I invite you to the dazzling world of male 
bonding!
[FI] I-I don't wanna enter this world of male bonding...

[FI] Should I ask Akagi if he has any tips on how to 
deal with Sena?
[FI] ...Oh, speak of the devil, he texted me.

SPEAKER: SPK_AKAGI
TEXT:
[FI] You're too close to my angel!!! Stop acting 
love-struck and find the perpetrator already!!
[FI] And... he's flipping out.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Senpai, come on, over here!

[FI] I'm out of options. I can't talk to Akagi, so it's time 
to prepare myself for the worst...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Hey, check out this character's muscular body!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You sound like some kind of e-commerce director, 
getting worked up like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] If you buy this game right now, I'll throw in an 
absolutely filthy doujinshi set!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm not buying it, alright?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] But wait, there's more! Recommended for 
beginners, it comes with another doujinshi featuring 
a middle-aged character beautified up to 120%!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Thanks for being considerate, but I'm definitely not 
buying it, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I, Akagi Sena, will shoulder the burden of the 
interest rates as well as the cost!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So you already planned on buying it all!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Ehehe, I'm going to the register!

[FI] Geez, this girl... when you think everyone around you has 
similar hobbies, you go on as much as you want. If we're  
gonna make this game, I have to suppress this part of her...
[FI] I don't know why I have to be here though!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Senpai, over here!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What is it this time...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] There's a drama CD I've been wanting for you to 
hear... There's a demo here, so give it a listen!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Alright already...

[FI] This situation kinda reminds me of when Kirino and 
I first started playing H-games together.

SPEAKER: SPK_BOY_A
TEXT:
[FI] Yes... open up your throat and drink it all up. My 
Longinus spear...

SPEAKER: SPK_BOY_B
TEXT: [FI] I-Impossible... It's way too big...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=33]Impossible?! That's my line! I can't 
stand listening to this![/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Now, now, just give it another listen... after all, this 
CD...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-What's with that bold grin?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] These voice actors' voices sounds really familiar 
huh? President and Makabe-senpai...

[FI] With Sena constantly pushing me on, I put the 
headphones on again...

SPEAKER: SPK_BOY_A
TEXT:
[FI] I'm gonna plug it up... this mouth that constantly 
teases me...

SPEAKER: SPK_BOY_B
TEXT: [FI] Eek, please don't... punish me... Ah, President...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] [font_size=28]Did he just say President!?[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=33]Exactly!![/font_size] Even the premise is 
exactly the same! Those two...

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] The president who daydreams but is aggressive in bed, 
together with the cutie who makes rude remarks being on 
the receiving end... [font_size=31]Oo[/font_size][font_size=29]hi[/font_size][font_size=26]hi[/font_size][font_size=24]hi[/font_size][font_size=22]hi[/font_size]hi[font_size=22]hi[/font_size][font_size=24]hi[/font_size][font_size=26]hi[/font_size][font_size=29]hi[/font_size][font_size=31]hi[/font_size][font_size=29]hi[/font_size][font_size=26]hi[/font_size][font_size=24]hi[/font_size][font_size=22]hi[/font_size]hi[font_size=22]hi[/font_size][font_size=24]hi[/font_size]
[FI] A demonic smile popped up on her face...

[FI] Where did the cute underclassman that I met at 
the station disappear to...

[FI] Then again, I felt a great urge to retreat as we 
approached the goods.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Y-You know, we can research this without plunging 
right into the thick of things, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Eh-, don't stand so far away and gawk, come closer 
please. There's a drama CD I absolutely want you 
to hear.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] N-No thanks, I don't want to get in too deep today, 
so let's stop here! Baby steps, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Really...? The voice actor sounds exactly like 
Makabe-senpai, it's really interesting.

[FI] Yeah well... that does sound interesting, but it doesn't 
sound like something I have to experience.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Well, I guess this is good for starters. Even Onii-chan 
watched from afar at first.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] O-Okay. Sorry.
[FI] Phew. Looks like I succeeded in avoiding danger...

[FI] With Sena in a satisfied trance, the Akiba BL tour 
was over.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Um... Senpai. There is one more thing I need to do in 
Akiba. If possible, I would like your help...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-What is it? If it isn't about BL then I'll help.

[FI] With how things have turned out, my precautions 
have gotten stronger.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] I want to... buy Onii-chan a present before I head 
back home.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] For Akagi? Is his birthday coming up?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] ...No, it's a makeup present.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] After hearing what you had to say, I gave a lot of 
thought about Onii-chan.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] It's true that Onii-chan is creepy, and it was 
annoying how persistent his texts were... Still, he's 
really kind to me.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] He's my precious Onii-chan... That's what I felt.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Therefore, I want to buy him a present as an 
apology for avoiding him.

[FI] She looked up to me with a worried face, and I 
was plunged into her eyes-

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hnnnnnnnnnnng!!!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] ...? What's the matter, Senpai?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, nothing... It's nothing!

[FI] She's so cute it's illegal? Somebody else's little 
sister can't be this cute!

[FI] Her mannerisms and behavior are nice. My sister 
could learn a thing or two.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] So, how about it, Senpai... Will you accompany me 
to buy a present?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Yeah, of course. If it's to help both of you reconcile, 
then it all works out.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Ehehe, thanks a lot. You're really nice, Senpai.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No way.

[FI] Well I did give both of them life counseling. If 
everything ends well, the counseling was worth it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] Thank goodness... I don't really know what would 
make him happy, I had some trouble over what to 
buy him.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] You've gone to Akiba with him before, so you 
should know what kind of present he would like?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, that's right. When I was with him-

[FI] Thinking back, we stood in front of a large adult 
goods shop. That time he bought a... Yeah, no other 
words to describe it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] He's a soccer-maniac, so he'll like a soccer game, 
probably.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Huh, something from a bargain bin is fine then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Oh it's no problem at all, doesn't matter if the roster 
of players is dated, he'll enjoy it, so don't worry.
[FI] As long as it's a present from Sena, he'll be happy.

[FI] You're a lot better off compared to me, who was 
entrusted with Kirino's erotic games. Be thankful, 
Akagi!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Well then, we're done with the BL research and 
shopping for Akagi's present, so that's all for the 
day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] It's still pretty early though, wanna grab a bite 
before we head back?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] ? What are you saying, Senpai?

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] We're not done. Or rather, we're just getting 
started.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Huh?
[FI] A shiver ran down my spine.

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT:
[FI] That was just the opening act of the BL research. 
The real performance begins now.

[FI] ...I don't really get it, but I can sense that great peril 
awaits!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] Come on, let's get on the train.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, wait, where are you dragging me off to!

SPEAKER: SPK_SENA
TEXT: [FI] The rose-colored paradise of course~

[FI] Where are we going at this hour... My head was 
crammed full of this rotten stuff, I think my head is 
starting to ferment...
